title: Plugin category map
description: One table, not one document per object: which functional category each known plugin slug belongs to, so the analyzer can notice that a site is running two of the same kind of thing. Membership is a statement about what a plugin is for, never about whether it should be there. Nothing in this file names a tweak or implies an action.

categories.description: The functional categories, keyed by id. A category exists here before any plugin may claim it.

label.description: What this category is called in the interface. A name, not a judgement: what running two of these costs is reasoning, and reasoning belongs to the analyzer.

plugins.description: Plugin directory slug to category id. The slug is the first path segment of a plugin file, e.g. "wordpress-seo" for wordpress-seo/wp-seo.php.
